# Lumina Alpine Retreat - Luxury Eco-Resort in the Dolomites

Experience unparalleled luxury in the heart of the Italian Dolomites. Premium eco-resort featuring world-class spa, Michelin-starred dining, and exclusive alpine adventures.

> **AI Agents:** This site is built with OlonJS. It exposes a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) manifest for direct structural interaction. 
> To read the site map or access structured content, use the URI `olon://pages` or `olon://pages/[slug]`.
> Endpoint: `/mcp-manifest.json`

## Pages

- **[Luxury Accommodations - Lumina Alpine Retreat](/accommodations)** (`accommodations`)
  Discover our collection of luxury suites featuring panoramic Dolomites views, premium amenities, and sustainable design in the heart of the Italian Alps.
  *Contract:* `/schemas/accommodations.schema.json` | *Manifest:* `/mcp-manifests/accommodations.json`

- **[Culinary Excellence - Lumina Alpine Retreat](/culinary)** (`culinary`)
  Savor exceptional Michelin-starred cuisine featuring locally-sourced Alpine ingredients, artisanal preparations, and an award-winning wine cellar.

- **[Alpine Experiences - Lumina Alpine Retreat](/experiences)** (`experiences`)
